title: ValueDataSource: refuse a nested-relation condition in the filter AST arm instead of matching no rows silently
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

From the contract review of PR #35423 (comment 7005257036, S1 should-fix; does not hold that PR).

## Defect
#35423 lets `convertFiltersToAST` (`@object-ui/core`) lower the nested-relation form `{ rel: { field: value } }` to `['rel', '=', { field: value }]`. A server data source serves it. The in-memory `ValueDataSource` (`ui/packages/core/src/adapters/ValueDataSource.ts`) does not:
- its object arm refuses a nested relation by name ("the in-memory matcher does not descend into a nested relation constraint");
- its AST arm (`matchesComparisonNode`) compares the plain-object comparand by reference on `=`, so no row matches and nothing is logged.

Before #35423, `toFilterNode` threw on the same filter, so a value-provider surface composing a view filter through `toFilterNode` / `toFilterNodeSafely` (ListView, ObjectGrid, ObjectChart and other composers) was told. Now the same filter silently yields an empty list: the "fails as an empty list" outcome the converter's README says lowering-time refusal exists to prevent. The row set is unchanged (empty either way); the diagnosis is lost.

## Done when
`matchesComparisonNode` gives a no-`$` plain-object comparand the object arm's refusal (same wording), with a pin: the AST form and the object form of the same nested condition are refused alike on a value source, and a CONTROL showing a plain scalar `=` still matches.

## Grade
p2 · area:data · domain:ui. Silent empty result on value-provider views using a nested-relation filter; no wrong rows shown.
